sources.quote: 7.1 The supplier shall obtain written approval from Aurelia (PPAP resubmission) before shipping parts
after any of: a change of source, a change of material, a change of manufacturing process, or a change

findings.why: BR-220 belongs to PRG-X, whose customer is Aurelia. A new CNC program and fixture is a change of manufacturing process. Aurelia's manual revision 4 (which replaces revision 3) requires written approval (PPAP resubmission) before parts ship after such a change. It also requires 90 days' notice (section 7.2). I found no approval or deviation in force that covers this change. The only BR-220 deviation, DEV-118, covers packaging and has expired. The change is planned for next week, so the 90-day notice cannot be met either.
